public_rationale: In a piece published 2026-07-15, he wrote that the only reason the AI bubble has kept going is that OpenAI has yet to collapse. He added that its failure would be the bubble's Lehman Brothers moment. The claim names a single cause. Testing it would mean seeing whether the boom ends without OpenAI's survival. The evidence packet records that OpenAI has not collapsed, so that cannot be observed. The claim also gives no measure for the bubble continuing or ending. The packet contains no outcome evidence. It considered one source on xAI spending and did not use it, because spending by other firms does not test what would happen if OpenAI collapsed. With no measure and no observable test, the claim cannot be graded true or false.
limitations: The packet contains no evidence on whether the AI boom depends on OpenAI's survival.
The claim gives no measure for 'the AI bubble' or for it continuing or ending.
The packet does not assess other possible causes of continued AI spending.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The only reason the AI bubble has lasted this long is that OpenAI has not yet collapsed.

statement.excerpt: As much as this’ll piss some people off, I fully believe that the only reason this has kept going so long is that OpenAI has yet to collapse.

from_speaker: "the only reason this has kept going so long"
its failure "would be a watershed moment — the Lehman Brothers of the AI bubble"
"Absent this wake-up call, NVIDIA has continued to sell GPUs"
our_interpretation: The claim is about why the AI boom continues. Its core is a counterfactual: if OpenAI collapsed, the boom would end. OpenAI has not collapsed, so that alternative world cannot be observed.

"Only reason" means a single cause. 'This' (the AI bubble) and 'kept going' have no stated measure. Firms naming other reasons for spending would not show his counterfactual is wrong, and their silence would not show it is right.
So the claim cannot be checked against public evidence, and it is graded not adjudicable rather than true or false.
criteria.support_condition: None available. Support would need to show that the boom would have ended without OpenAI's continued survival, which cannot be observed while OpenAI survives.
criteria.contradiction_condition: None available either. To contradict the claim you would have to watch OpenAI collapse while the boom carried on, and that has not happened. Investment drivers that companies state do not test his counterfactual.
